name: Doombringer
desc: A shield made with offensive attacks in mind. The pile power has been pushed to the utmost limit, resulting in almost explosive attacks with accompanying kickback. Only the strongest, most tenacious folks can master one of these.

eff.name: Avenger
eff.desc1: Increases damage by [Lv. x 3]% when your HP is at 50% or lower.

eff.name: Piercing Pile
eff.desc1: Increases damage by [Lv. x 4]% when attacking a stunned enemy.

eff.name: Sanguine Crystal
eff.desc1: Consumes 10 HP when attacking to increase damage by [Lv. x 2]%.
